title: A widget toolkit with mixins
description:
Model user-interface widgets with classes, mixins and events.

```
panel "settings" (10, 10, 200x120)
  label "Volume"
  slider volume 0.8   -> changed to 0.5: "volume changed" sent
  button "Save"       -> clicked: settings saved
hovered: button "Save"
```

starter.main.lua:
local Widget = {}
Widget.__index = Widget
function Widget.new(x, y, w, h) return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h }, Widget) end
print(Widget.new(10, 10, 200, 120).w)

hints: `include(Button, Clickable)` copies the mixin's functions into the class table (lesson 8.04).
A point is inside a widget when `x <= px < x + w` and `y <= py < y + h`.
requirements: A base `Widget` class with position and size, built with `__call` constructors.
Mixins `Clickable`, `Hoverable` and `Emitter` copied into the widget classes that need them.
A panel that holds children (composition) and passes clicks to the child under the mouse.
stretch: Add keyboard focus that moves between clickable widgets with Tab.
